title: Resolve all Route–Gate pairs without random outcome decisions
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_PILOT.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the frozen sources under docs/design/ first. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is the canonical six-node deterministic gameplay contract; completed foundation APIs remain compatibility history. Implement new versioned APIs without changing the completed T01–T10 contracts. Work only in declared ownership; no manifests, shared exports or dependencies unless explicitly owned. Engine production remains ES2022-only, pure and independent from Firebase, Node, browser, UI and Capacitor. Use original synthetic test data and injected authority time/entropy; no clocks or global randomness in engine. Never expose seed, roles, private inputs or raw audit data through public output. Do not invent a rule where an explicit design gap is named. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests and npm run check; report contract changes and observed results. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, cloud deployment, credentials or budget changes. Export resolveOperationV1 using both locked choices and the exact current incident matrix: safeRoute+safeGate→Repair+1; corruptRoute+corruptGate→Sabotage+1; every other pair→Anomaly without track movement. Require both valid axes and one resolution per incident/round. Result calculation must consume zero random values and be independent of roles/claims/UI. Return an authority result plus minimal public Repair/Sabotage/Anomaly/incident reference; follow-on track/Anomaly reducers apply effects separately.
acceptance: All54 matrix cells produce the canonical result with no RNG advancement, including the three explicit I01 acceptance examples.
Incomplete, stale, mismatched-axis/incident or already-resolved operations cannot resolve or apply twice.
Public result data never proves another participant choice, diagnostic or alignment.
Scoped lint, typecheck and tests plus npm run check pass; legacy APIs retain compatibility and only owned files change.
